ledger: hand and block row | single green block 2 on wood table | extended sequence of numbered blocks (2, 3, 2, 2, 3, 5, 2, 6, 3) | new blocks spontaneously materialize in the gap whenever the hand slides the rightmost block further right

findings.description: As the hand slides the rightmost block to the right, new numbered blocks (beige '2' and light blue '3') spontaneously materialize in the opening space without being placed by the hand.
As the hand pulls the end block further to the right, additional blocks labeled 5, 2, and 6 continuously spawn out of thin air to fill the gap behind the sliding block.
